description: This file defines the 'Pipe' utility class containing static methods to create and combine Akka stream graphs for stream processing, such as joining filters and flows.

classes.name: Pipe
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to join Akka stream components, such as filters, sinks, and flows.

methods.name: joinFilteredSink
methods.description: Creates a graph that attaches a sink to the output port of a filter with two outputs, connecting the filter's first output to the sink; returns a combined flow.

methods.name: joinUnhandledSink
methods.description: Creates a graph attaching a sink to the unhandled (second) output port of a filter, returning a flow that passes through handled messages.

methods.name: joinFilteredFlow
methods.description: Creates a graph that inserts a flow into the unhandled output port of a filter, returning a 'fan out' shape for further composition.

methods.name: joinFlows
methods.description: Chains a collection of flows into a single flow by composing them in sequence.
